title: Transparent photo slots refuse opaque JPEG placement before upload
steps: Index an avatar photo frame with a transparent content-map requirement.
Run specific, any-real and person photo paths on hideable and nonhideable slots.
Export historical JPEG mappings and call direct photo cutters.
expect: Transparency requirements survive frame indexing and prevent unsupported picker work.
Hideable frames use supported hiding; nonhideable frames return to the planner without generating people.
Opaque JPEG export and cutters refuse before upload; ordinary photos and true cutouts retain their existing paths.
fence: content-map transparency carried into image eligibility, cutters and export
